nodes.label: Data Integrity Policy
nodes.rationale: Never present inferred, extrapolated, or assumed information as retrieved fact; explicitly distinguish retrieved vs inferred and tested vs estimated.

nodes.label: claude-seo Plugin (canonical SEO plugin)
nodes.rationale: Local fork with its own git repo; absorbed the best of aakash-seo on 2026-07-06, so aakash-seo must never be reinstalled and the fork must not be re-cloned or overwritten.

nodes.label: linkedin Skill (write / feed engage / reply modes)
nodes.norm_label: linkedin skill (write / feed engage / reply modes)

nodes.label: ai-overview-scraper Agent
nodes.rationale: Collects AI-search citation data only (no analysis) so the dataset stays faithful; hard fail-honestly rule: on CAPTCHA/login wall/missing browser MCP, stop, write partial data, and report rather than fabricate.

nodes.label: Pollinations Keyless Image Generation
nodes.rationale: Chosen because it is free, keyless, verified working over plain urllib GET; Gemini image API is paid-only (free tier returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED limit:0); trade-offs accepted: 768x768 cap, no SLA, prompts may be publicly cached.

nodes.label: LinkedIn Modern Images API Upload Flow
nodes.rationale: Modern /rest/images?action=initializeUpload -> PUT bytes -> urn:li:image chosen over legacy /v2/assets registerUpload because the existing script already posts to /rest/posts; legacy digitalmediaAsset URNs are the wrong companion for /rest/posts.
nodes.norm_label: linkedin modern images api upload flow

nodes.label: Previewable Image Generation Step
nodes.rationale: Image generation runs as a separate CLI step and the posting script takes a file path (not a prompt) so the skill's mandatory approval gate holds: the user must see the image before it publishes, and any user-supplied image is a drop-in.

nodes.label: Hub Router Pattern
nodes.rationale: Claude Code skill discovery is flat (one folder + SKILL.md, no nesting), so ~44 skill entries were collapsed into themed router hubs whose frontmatter carries all trigger phrases and whose body is a dispatch table pointing (by path, never by copy) at canonical plugin files. Trade-offs accepted: flat slash commands like /seo-audit stop working, and each invocation adds one indirection hop; expected gain: 6 rich hub descriptions auto-invoke better than 50 competing ones.

nodes.label: aakash-seo to claude-seo Best-of Merge
nodes.rationale: 10 of aakash-seo's 11 skills duplicated a claude-seo skill (including a same-name seo-audit collision), so claude-seo was kept as base, superior sections were grafted in, the unique broken-links skill ported, and aakash-seo archived as a git bundle before deletion so the retirement is reversible.
